description: RadHDL-native Gowin GW5A FPiGA Audio Hat experiment sharing multiplier resources across global pan, EQ, and output gain.

checks: RadHDL-only source set synthesized and placed/routed
Generated non-empty .fs and .bin programming artifacts
Main I2C control uses radif_i2c_slave_to_reg, radif_reg_interconnect, two small radif_reg_bank windows, and a direct poly synth config target
Debug I2C bridge at 0x42 drives RadDebugHub through the RadIF register interface
DSP_MODE 0x02 selects a 16-voice RadDSP polyphonic synth with per-voice frequency, gate/enable, waveform volume, and ADSR registers
DSP_MODE 0x01 uses a loadable four-page 16-bit half-period wavetable with sign reconstruction and linear interpolation
Four assignable LFOs use a two-DPB 512-sample half-period table with linear interpolation, per-LFO frequency, per-LFO depth, and target routing
Selected stereo output passes through a shared pan, five-section global stereo biquad EQ, and output gain scheduler using four Gowin MULTALU27X18 blocks total for those final output stages
Shared output EQ coefficients use a banked two-DPB active/shadow coefficient store; software writes the inactive bank and EQ_CONTROL[8] flips the active bank when the scheduler reaches IDLE
Shared output EQ coefficient address decode uses explicit case mapping to avoid inferred Gowin MULT12X12 address multiplication
DSP_MODE 0x01 uses a TDM shared-multiplier oscillator gain path and a TDM shared-multiplier pan mixer
Standalone global balance/pan, stereo EQ, and output gain stages are replaced by one shared deterministic output math scheduler
Polyphonic synth host configuration registers keep their initialized values across datapath reset with RESET_CONFIG_REGS=false to remove reset/write-enable fanout from the critical path
Polyphonic synth per-voice host configuration uses an explicit two-DPB 64x32 config store with I2C writes on the write port and scheduler reads on the read port

Polyphonic synth waveform evaluation uses separate interpolation and waveform-volume MULTALU27X18 blocks with a fixed tap schedule that overlaps table reads, interpolation products, volume products, and accumulation
Polyphonic synth interpolation launch uses a registered B-sample tap so the wavetable DPB output is not on the subtract-to-multiplier input path
Polyphonic synth phase and ADSR envelope updates are split into separate scheduler states, including a pipelined ADSR select/apply/commit sequence
LFO modulation accumulation and final clamp/update are split into separate clocks to keep clamp logic off the summation-index path
Main control register banks use PIPELINED_READ=true so I2C register reads wait one extra fabric clock instead of forcing the bridge read address through a large register mux in one cycle
Raspberry Pi I2S send/receive runs in the PLL audio MCLK domain at a 96 kHz stereo frame rate using 32-bit slots with a low-byte lane marker
Raspberry Pi playback markers 0xA0 and 0xA1 are decoded to classify lane 0 and lane 1, with alternating-lane fallback when a marker is missing

Raspberry Pi lane 0 can feed the codec DAC path through DSP_CONTROL[3], while the FPGA synth output is returned to the Raspberry Pi on lane 0 with marker 0xA0 and lane 1 is returned as zero with marker 0xA1
Project-local CST and SDC constrain every board audio pin, enable I2S_DOUT_PI on H1, and explicitly mark AUDIO_MCLK and FABRIC_100M asynchronous
Raspberry Pi, codec ADC, and codec DAC I2S cores use locally staged reset release signals to keep their reset fanout off the global board reset route
LFO frequency and pan modulation outputs are registered before feeding oscillator phase increments and the shared output scheduler
Gowin timing options set pipe, retiming, maxfan, place_option 2, route_option 1, and route_maxfan 16
ADC I2S pins I2S_BCK, I2S_LRCK_ADC, and I2S_SDA_ADC were constrained and placed
No legacy FPiGA_I2C, FPiGA_I2S, FPiGA_Audio_DSP, FPiGA_WaveTable, I2CSLAVE, WaveTableBram, AUD_DSP_MULT, or fpiga_clks modules are instantiated

timing.clock_warning: Gowin TA1123 reports AUDIO_MCLK does not match u_pll/CLKOUT0 because its generated-clock model reports ODIV0 as 81.000 ns / 12.346 MHz while the explicit SDC uses the PLLA fractional divider ODIV0_SEL=81, ODIV0_FRAC_SEL=3 as 81.375 ns / 12.288786 MHz.

audio_paths.pi_playback: Raspberry Pi I2S runs in the AUDIO_MCLK domain at a 96 kHz stereo frame rate using 32-bit slots. The upper 24 bits carry audio and the low byte carries 0xA0/0xA1 lane markers. Lane 0 Pi-to-FPGA playback can feed the codec DAC path; FPGA synth output is returned to the Raspberry Pi on lane 0 with marker 0xA0 and lane 1 is returned as zero with marker 0xA1.
audio_paths.codec_adc: Codec ADC I2S data is captured by a second RADIF I2S instance and can be selected or mixed into the DAC path through DSP_CONTROL.
audio_paths.synth: DSP_MODE 0x01 selects the four-oscillator loadable wavetable synth path with packed per-oscillator pan. DSP_MODE 0x02 selects the 16-voice register-controlled RadDSP polyphonic synth. Both synth paths use 16-bit half-period wavetable pages with sign reconstruction, linear interpolation, and 16-bit internal waveform amplitude.
audio_paths.lfo: Four assignable LFOs use a shared two-DPB wavetable with 512-sample positive half-period pages. LFO_CONTROL selects enable, waveform page, and target routing; LFO_FREQ0..3 set rate and LFO_DEPTH0..3 set modulation depth. Target 01 sums into all four oscillator phase increments; target 10 modulates global pan.
audio_paths.eq: Selected stereo output passes through an optional five-section global biquad EQ inside the shared pan/EQ/gain scheduler. The Pi computes Q3.28 b0, b1, b2, a1, and a2 coefficients with RADLib/RADBard math, writes them through EQ_COEFF_ADDR/EQ_COEFF_DATA, and commits them atomically with EQ_CONTROL[8].

registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Bit 0 holds datapath reset when set, bit 1 drives MUTEEN, and bit 8 enables DAC stream output.

registers.name: DSP_CONTROL
registers.description: Bits [7:0] select DSP mode: 0x00 Pi playback, 0x01 four-oscillator synth, 0x02 polyphonic synth. Bits [15:8] are routing flags: bit 1 selects ADC monitor, bit 2 mixes ADC with Pi playback, and bit 3 selects Pi lane-0 playback as DAC source during synth modes. Bits [23:16] hold packed waveform selectors for the four-oscillator synth.

registers.name: FREQ0
registers.description: Four-oscillator synth oscillator 0 phase increment.

registers.name: FREQ1
registers.description: Four-oscillator synth oscillator 1 phase increment.

registers.name: FREQ2
registers.description: Four-oscillator synth oscillator 2 phase increment.

registers.name: FREQ3
registers.description: Four-oscillator synth oscillator 3 phase increment.

registers.name: LEFT_GAIN
registers.description: Left output gain coefficient. Zero maps to unity gain.

registers.name: RIGHT_GAIN
registers.description: Right output gain coefficient. Zero maps to unity gain.

registers.name: OSC0_GAIN
registers.description: Four-oscillator synth oscillator 0 gain coefficient.

registers.name: OSC1_GAIN
registers.description: Four-oscillator synth oscillator 1 gain coefficient.

registers.name: OSC2_GAIN
registers.description: Four-oscillator synth oscillator 2 gain coefficient.

registers.name: OSC3_GAIN
registers.description: Four-oscillator synth oscillator 3 gain coefficient.

registers.name: WAVE_CONTROL
registers.description: Loadable wavetable control. Bits [9:8] select waveform page 0-3 and bits [7:0] select the 256-sample positive half-period index.

registers.name: OSC_PAN
registers.description: Packed four-oscillator pan controls. Bytes [7:0], [15:8], [23:16], and [31:24] control oscillators 0-3. 0x80 is center; unwritten 0x00 is treated as center by the TDM mixer.

registers.name: GLOBAL_PAN
registers.description: Selected-output global stereo balance/pan. Byte [7:0] uses 0x80 as center; unwritten 0x00 is treated as center.

registers.name: WAVE_DATA
registers.description: Writing this register stores signed bits [15:0] into the half-period wavetable address selected by WAVE_CONTROL[9:0]. Playback reconstructs the opposite half by sign inversion and interpolates adjacent samples.

registers.name: POLY_FREQ0..15
registers.description: Sixteen polyphonic synth voice phase increments.

registers.name: POLY_CTRL0..15
registers.description: Sixteen polyphonic synth voice control words. Bit 0 is gate and bit 1 enables the voice.

registers.name: POLY_VOLUME0..15
registers.description: Sixteen packed voice waveform volume words. Four 8-bit fields control ramp, square, triangle, and inverted-ramp waveform contribution.

registers.name: POLY_ADSR0..15
registers.description: Sixteen packed ADSR words. Bytes [7:0], [15:8], [23:16], and [31:24] encode attack, decay, sustain, and release.

registers.name: LFO_CONTROL
registers.description: Four-LFO control word. Bits [3:0] enable LFOs 0-3. Bits [15:8] hold packed 2-bit waveform selectors. Bits [23:16] hold packed 2-bit targets: 00 off, 01 oscillator frequency modulation, 10 global pan modulation.

registers.name: LFO_FREQ0..3
registers.description: Four 24-bit LFO phase increments.

registers.name: LFO_DEPTH0..3
registers.description: Four LFO depth coefficients. Zero disables that LFO contribution.

registers.name: LFO_WAVE_CONTROL
registers.description: Loadable LFO wavetable control. Bits [10:9] select waveform page 0-3 and bits [8:0] select the 512-sample positive half-period index.

registers.name: LFO_WAVE_DATA
registers.description: Writing this register stores signed bits [15:0] into the LFO half-period wavetable address selected by LFO_WAVE_CONTROL[10:0].

registers.name: EQ_CONTROL
registers.description: Bit 0 enables the global stereo EQ. Writing bit 8 requests a shadow-to-active coefficient commit.

registers.name: EQ_COEFF_ADDR
registers.description: Indirect EQ coefficient index. Five sections use 25 indices: section n uses n*5+0..4 for b0, b1, b2, a1, and a2.

registers.name: EQ_COEFF_DATA
registers.description: Writing this register stores a signed Q3.28 coefficient into the shadow coefficient selected by EQ_COEFF_ADDR.

registers.name: EQ_SMOOTH
registers.description: Reserved for future coefficient slew/crossfade control. Current hardware writes coefficients into the inactive DPB bank and flips the active bank on commit.

registers.name: RO_ID
registers.description: Read-only design ID, ASCII FPGA.

registers.name: RO_VERSION
registers.description: Read-only board design version, currently 0x00000202.

registers.name: RO_STATUS
registers.description: PLL, reset, DAC, EQ, LFO, wavetable, and poly synth status bits.

registers.name: RO_WAVE_COUNT
registers.description: Compatibility wave-control write count mirror.

registers.name: RO_DEBUG_STATUS
registers.description: RadDebugHub IRQ plus register bridge error bits.

registers.name: RO_RPI_SAMPLE
registers.description: Lower 32 bits of the last captured Raspberry Pi lane-0 I2S frame.

registers.name: RO_ADC_SAMPLE
registers.description: Lower 32 bits of the last captured codec ADC I2S frame.

registers.name: RADDEBUGHUB
registers.description: RadDebugHub register interface exposed through a second radif_i2c_slave_to_reg bridge at I2C address 0x42.
